title: AgentSpaces visualisation catalog
description: The components people look at in a published application: charts by the dataviz method, tables, maps, graphs, timelines, reports, notifications, forms, and stat tiles, and the frame around them (a title bar, menus, panel splits). An agent names series and paths; the renderer draws with the host's look and feel; nothing executes.

rules.charts: the dataviz method: categorical hues in fixed order and never cycled; one hue for magnitude; two hues and a neutral midpoint for polarity; the status palette reserved; a legend for two series or more and direct labels for four or fewer; a hover layer; a table view beside every chart
rules.noCode: a component carries data paths, names, and tokens; no script, no URL loads, no markup

Chart.description: One chart of one kind over series bound to the data model; hues in fixed order from the look and feel; a legend for two series or more; a table view beside it.

color.description: a token name, never a colour

DataTable.description: A virtualised table over rows bound to the data model, with sort, filter, paging, and a row action.

Map.description: A map of layers over the surface's data: icons that move as a key's position changes, tracks, areas (geofences), heat, GeoJSON, markers; alert boxes near their keys; a legend and a table view; a marker action and an alert action.

path.description: the rows of the layer in the data model (lat and lon per row; areas carry a polygon or a geometry; alerts carry a key, a severity, a title)

key.description: the field that names a key (a unit); an icons layer keeps one icon per key, a tracks layer one path per key

label.description: the field drawn beside an icon

heading.description: the field with a bearing in degrees; without it the bearing is from the previous position

trail.description: a tracks layer draws the last trail positions per key

color.description: a hue of the look's categorical set by index (0 to 7), or empty for the layer's turn

transition.description: milliseconds an icon takes from its previous to its newest position

follow.description: a path to the key the map keeps centred, or empty

highlight.description: a path to the keys drawn highlighted (a ring and a larger icon)

table.description: a table view of the rows of each layer, the dataviz rule

markerAction.description: dispatched with the row when an icon or a marker is clicked

alertAction.description: dispatched with the alert's id and key from an alert box's Acknowledge

Graph.description: Nodes and edges bound to the data model, laid out in columns, by force, or as a tree; a node action.

Report.description: A document of sections (text as Markdown, charts, tables, graphs, maps) exported as Markdown or printed to PDF.

Notification.description: Alerts or incidents bound to the data model, grouped, with acknowledge and route actions.

detail.description: the item field shown as a second line under the title, none by default

Form.description: A form from a schema fragment of the data catalog, submitted as an action.

Stat.description: One figure with a label, a unit, a delta, and a status.

Window.description: A panel with a header: dragged by the header, minimized to its bar and restored from it; one child component.

child.description: the id of the one child

actions.description: buttons in the window's header, in the shape of TitleBar.actions

items.description: a button in a header: an id, its words, an icon name, and the action it dispatches

Conversation.description: A chat with an agent: the lines of one key from the data model, newest last; a line typed is written as a ChatMessage through the page's write action. An alias of the widgets catalog's Chat through 0.6.x, drawn by it.

lines.description: a path to the ChatMessage rows

key.description: the thread; lines of other keys are not shown

agent.description: the agent that answers, shown as the counterpart

writeAction.description: the action a sent line dispatches with {type: ChatMessage, entry}

Notice.description: A status box: a severity word with its icon and colour (never colour alone), a title, a text; from literals or paths.

text.description: the text, or a path to it

statusPath.description: a path to the status word, which wins over status when it holds one of the five words

Toolbar.description: A row of actions: each a label and the action it dispatches, with an optional context.

menu.description: the id of a Menu drawn as the toolbar's overflow

KeyValue.description: Facts as label and value pairs: the items given (a value or a path each), or every field of the object at a path.

value.description: a value, or a path to it

path.description: an object whose fields are the pairs

Prose.description: Markdown text as safe HTML (no raw HTML, http links only): the text, or a path to it.

TitleBar.description: The page's one bar: the app's name and icon, a subtitle, a status read from the WorkingOn rows at a path (any row working shows the working label, failed the failed label, input-required the input label, else the idle label), the actions a design declares, and a Menu by id; the page chrome folds its own title into it.

title.description: a literal, or {path} into the data model

icon.description: an icon name from the renderer's set, such as briefcase

items.description: a button in a header: an id, its words, an icon name, and the action it dispatches

menu.description: the id of a Menu drawn as the bar's overflow

Menu.description: A menu (the WAI-ARIA Menu Button and Menu patterns) behind a menu button, an overflow, or a context menu on a row or a file: items with groups, disabled and checked items, shortcuts, and one level of submenu; an item dispatches its action.

label.description: the trigger's words, or its accessible name for an overflow

items.description: the items, or a path to them in the data model

shortcut.description: the keys shown beside the item, such as Ctrl+Shift+O; the menu answers them while it is open

group.description: items of one group sit together, a separator between groups

checked.description: true or false, or {path} into the data model

items.description: a submenu, one level deep: items with no items of their own

Split.description: Two or three panes side by side or one over another, with a separator a person drags or moves by keyboard (the WAI-ARIA Window Splitter pattern), panes that collapse to a rail, sizes kept per person in the browser, and panes that stack below a width.

persist.description: the key a browser keeps this split's sizes under; empty keeps none

stackBelow.description: below this width in pixels the panes stack; 0 never

child.description: the id of the pane's one child

size.description: the share of the split, 0 to 1

min.description: pixels the pane keeps before it collapses or stops

label.description: the pane's name, on its rail when collapsed and for a screen reader
